title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A1–B1）
section: 第 751–800 個單字（CEFR A1 基礎入門）

examples.en: Taiwan is a wonderful place to live and travel.
examples.zh: 台灣是一個非常適合居住與旅遊的好地方。

examples.en: Place the fragile glassware carefully on the bottom shelf.
examples.zh: 將易碎的玻璃器皿小心地放置在底層架子上。

examples.en: In the first place, we should consider everyone's safety before proceeding.
examples.zh: 首先，在進行之前我們應該優先考量每個人的安全。

examples.en: Taipei 101 is one of the tallest green buildings.
examples.zh: 台北 101 是最高的地標綠建築之一。

examples.en: The university constructed a modern science building on campus.
examples.zh: 這所大學在校園內興建了一棟現代化的理學大樓。

examples.en: Building strong relationships requires mutual trust and patience.
examples.zh: 建立深厚穩固的人際關係需要互相信任與耐心。

examples.en: Be cautious of motorcycles when crossing the road.
examples.zh: 過馬路時請當心機車。

examples.en: We embarked on an unforgettable scenic road trip along the east coast.
examples.zh: 我們踏上了一趟沿著東海岸令人難忘的公路之旅。

examples.en: The road to achieving mastery requires persistent dedication.
examples.zh: 通往精通熟練的道路需要堅持不懈的投入。

examples.en: Always use the crosswalk when crossing the street.
examples.zh: 過馬路時務必走斑馬線。

examples.en: Drivers must yield right of way to pedestrians on crosswalks.
examples.zh: 駕駛在斑馬線上必須禮讓行人先行。

examples.en: The city repainted the bright white lines of the crosswalk outside the elementary school.
examples.zh: 市政府重新粉刷了小學校門口外明亮的斑馬線白色標線。

examples.en: Pedestrians should walk on the designated sidewalk.
examples.zh: 行人應走在專用的人行道上。

examples.en: Keep bicycles and electric scooters off crowded pedestrian sidewalks.
examples.zh: 請勿將自行車和電動滑板車騎上擁擠的行人徒步人行道。

examples.en: Street cafes set up outdoor dining tables and umbrellas along the broad sidewalk.
examples.zh: 街頭咖啡館在寬敞的人行道旁擺設了戶外餐桌與陽傘。

examples.en: Stop when the traffic light turns red.
examples.zh: 紅綠燈亮紅燈時請停下。

examples.en: The vehicle proceeded cautiously as the traffic light switched to green.
examples.zh: 當號誌燈轉為綠燈時，車輛謹慎前行。

examples.en: Smart traffic light systems adjust light cycles according to real-time traffic flow.
examples.zh: 智慧型交通號誌系統會根據即時車流量自動調整紅綠燈秒數週期。

examples.en: The bridge connects the two riverbanks together.
examples.zh: 這座橋樑將兩座河岸連接在一起。

examples.en: Cultural exchange programs help bridge misunderstandings between different nations.
examples.zh: 文化交流計畫有助於消除各國之間的誤解並搭建溝通橋樑。

examples.en: The scenic suspension bridge sways gently in the mountain breeze.
examples.zh: 這座風景秀麗的吊橋在山谷微風中輕輕搖曳。

examples.en: If you lose your purse, report to the police station.
examples.zh: 如果遺失皮夾，請去派出所報案。

examples.en: The local police station is situated right next to the town hall.
examples.zh: 當地的警察局就座落在鎮公所隔壁。

examples.en: Helpful police officers at the station assisted the lost tourist in finding her hotel.
examples.zh: 派出所熱心的警察協助迷路的外國觀光客找到了飯店。

examples.en: Fire trucks rushed out of the fire station quickly.
examples.zh: 消防車迅速駛出消防局。

examples.en: Local elementary school students visited the fire station on an educational field trip.
examples.zh: 當地的國小學生造訪了消防局進行教育性的校外教學參訪。

examples.en: The fire station operates twenty-four hours a day to safeguard the neighborhood.
examples.zh: 這座消防局全天候二十四小時運作以守護社區安全。

examples.en: We need to stop by the gas station to fill up the tank.
examples.zh: 我們需要順道去加油站把油箱加滿。

examples.en: Modern gas stations often feature convenience stores and clean restrooms.
examples.zh: 現代化的加油站通常附設便利商店與乾淨的洗手間。

examples.en: Many gas stations now offer high-speed electric vehicle charging stations.
examples.zh: 許多加油站現在都增設了高速電動車充電樁。

examples.en: There is an underground parking lot below the mall.
examples.zh: 購物中心地下設有室內停車場。

examples.en: The outdoor parking lot was completely filled to capacity on the holiday weekend.
examples.zh: 連假週末時室外停車場完全停滿了車輛。

examples.en: Customers who spend over a thousand dollars receive two hours of free parking lot validation.
examples.zh: 消費滿千元的顧客可獲得兩小時停車場免費折抵。

examples.en: You can buy vitamins and face masks at the pharmacy.
examples.zh: 你可以在藥局買到維他命和口罩。

examples.en: The licensed pharmacist at the community pharmacy explained the medication instructions clearly.
examples.zh: 社區藥局的執業藥師清楚地說明了用藥指示。

examples.en: The 24-hour pharmacy provides emergency prescription refills.
examples.zh: 這家二十四小時營業的藥局提供緊急處方箋調劑服務。

examples.en: SOGO is a renowned department store chain in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 太平洋 SOGO 是台灣著名的連鎖百貨公司。

examples.en: Crowds gathered early for the department store's annual anniversary sale.
examples.zh: 大批人潮很早就聚集等待百貨公司的一年一度週年慶特賣。

examples.en: The top floor of the department store houses fine dining restaurants.
examples.zh: 這棟百貨公司的頂樓匯聚了多間高級精緻餐廳。

examples.en: The National Palace Museum preserves precious historical relics.
examples.zh: 國立故宮博物院典藏珍貴歷史文物。

examples.en: Photography without flash is permitted inside the modern art museum.
examples.zh: 這座現代藝術博物館內允許在不開啟閃光燈的情況下拍照。

examples.en: Visitors can rent multilingual audio guides at the museum entrance.
examples.zh: 遊客可以在博物館入口處租借多語音訊語音導覽機。

examples.en: Longshan Temple in Taipei attracts millions of visitors.
examples.zh: 台北龍山寺每年吸引數百萬遊客造訪。

examples.en: Devotees light fragrant incense sticks to pray for health and peace at the temple.
examples.zh: 信眾們在寺廟裡點燃清香，祈求身體健康與萬事平安。

examples.en: The historic Buddhist temple features intricate dragon carvings on its curved roofs.
examples.zh: 這座歷史悠久的佛教寺廟飛簷屋頂上飾有精雕細琢的蟠龍雕刻。

examples.en: Many people attend morning service at church on Sunday.
examples.zh: 許多人每週日在教堂參加早晨禮拜。

examples.en: The wedding ceremony was held in a picturesque white countryside church.
examples.zh: 婚禮在一座風景如畫的鄉間白色教堂內舉行。

examples.en: The church community organizes charity food drives for needy families.
examples.zh: 教會團體為貧困家庭組織了慈善物資募集活動。

examples.en: Pack your bags the night before your school trip.
examples.zh: 在學校校外教學的前一晚把行李打包好。

examples.en: Don't forget to pack comfortable walking shoes and sunscreen.
examples.zh: 別忘了把舒適的步行鞋和防曬乳打包進行李。

examples.en: A pack of stray dogs wandered quietly along the river embankment.
examples.zh: 一群流浪狗沿著河堤安靜地漫步。

examples.en: Weigh your luggage before heading to the airport.
examples.zh: 出發去機場前先稱重確認你的行李。

examples.en: The airline allows two pieces of checked luggage per economy passenger.
examples.zh: 該航空公司允許每位經濟艙乘客免費託運兩件行李。

examples.en: Porters helped carry the heavy luggage up to our hotel room.
examples.zh: 行李員幫忙把沉重的行李搬運到我們的飯店客房。

examples.en: Remember to bring your valid passport when traveling abroad.
examples.zh: 出國旅遊時請記得攜帶有效護照。

examples.en: The immigration officer inspected her passport and stamped an entry visa.
examples.zh: 移民官員查驗了她的護照並蓋上入境章。

examples.en: Keep your passport in a secure zipper pouch to prevent accidental loss.
examples.zh: 將護照存放在安全的拉鍊收納袋中以防遺失。

examples.en: Many countries grant visa-free entry to Taiwanese tourists.
examples.zh: 許多國家對台灣遊客提供免簽入境待遇。

examples.en: You must apply for a student visa before starting university studies overseas.
examples.zh: 在前往海外展開大學學業之前，你必須先申請留學簽證。

examples.en: His working holiday visa expires at the end of next month.
examples.zh: 他的打工度假簽證將在下個月底到期。

examples.en: Our flight to Tokyo will board in thirty minutes.
examples.zh: 我們飛往東京的班機將在三十分鐘後登機。

examples.en: The direct international flight takes about three hours and forty minutes.
examples.zh: 這趟直飛國際航班航程約需三小時四十分鐘。

examples.en: Bad typhoon weather caused several domestic flights to be canceled.
examples.zh: 惡劣的颱風天氣導致數班國內線航班被迫取消。

examples.en: Please fasten your seatbelt and take your seat.
examples.zh: 請繫妥安全帶並在座位就座。

examples.en: She kindly gave up her subway seat to an elderly pregnant woman.
examples.zh: 她親切地將捷運座位讓給了一位年邁的孕婦。

examples.en: You can reserve your cinema seat online to get the best viewing angle.
examples.zh: 你可以事先在網路上劃位電影院座位以獲取最佳觀影視角。

examples.en: I prefer a window seat so I can see the clouds.
examples.zh: 我喜歡靠窗座位，這樣能看窗外的雲彩。

examples.en: Sitting in a window seat lets you admire the sparkling lights of the city below.
examples.zh: 坐在靠窗座位上能讓你欣賞下方城市閃爍璀璨的夜景。

examples.en: She requested a window seat when booking her bullet train ticket.
examples.zh: 她在訂高鐵票時特意要求劃了一個靠窗座位。

examples.en: An aisle seat is convenient for getting up during flights.
examples.zh: 靠走道座位在飛行途中方便起身走動。

examples.en: Tall passengers often prefer an aisle seat for extra legroom.
examples.zh: 身材高挑的乘客通常偏好靠走道座位以獲得更多伸展雙腿的空間。

examples.en: If you drink a lot of water, choose an aisle seat for easy restroom access.
examples.zh: 如果你喝很多水，選擇靠走道座位可以方便去洗手間。

examples.en: Have your passport and boarding pass ready at the gate.
examples.zh: 在登機門前請備妥護照與登機證。

examples.en: Passengers can store their digital boarding pass on their mobile phones.
examples.zh: 乘客可以將電子登機證儲存在手機中。

examples.en: Check the boarding time and departure gate number printed on your boarding pass.
examples.zh: 請留意列印在登機證上的登機時間與登機門編號。

examples.en: The plane landed smoothly on the runway.
examples.zh: 飛機平穩降落在跑道上。

examples.en: The farmer owns fertile agricultural land suitable for growing organic tea.
examples.zh: 這位農夫擁有適合種植有機茶葉的肥沃農地。

examples.en: After weeks sailing on rough seas, the sailors were overjoyed to see land.
examples.zh: 在波濤洶湧的大海上航行數週後，水手們看到陸地時欣喜若狂。

examples.en: Jiufen Old Street is packed with international tourists.
examples.zh: 九份老街擠滿了來自世界各國的觀光客。

examples.en: The tourist information center provides complimentary maps and local brochures.
examples.zh: 觀光旅遊資訊中心提供免費地圖與在地導覽手冊。

examples.en: Eco-conscious tourists respect local natural wildlife and cultural customs.
examples.zh: 具備環保意識的遊客會尊重當地的自然野生生態與文化習俗。

examples.en: The friendly local guide showed us around Tainan.
examples.zh: 親切的在地導遊帶領我們遊覽台南。

examples.en: Follow this step-by-step user guide to install the software correctly.
examples.zh: 請依照這份逐步操作指南來正確安裝軟體。

examples.en: A mentor can guide young professionals toward achieving their career goals.
examples.zh: 一位良師能指引年輕職場新鮮人邁向實現職業目標。

examples.en: Sun cakes from Taichung make wonderful souvenirs.
examples.zh: 台中的太陽餅是非常棒的伴手禮。

examples.en: She bought handmade wooden keychains as souvenirs for her close friends.
examples.zh: 她買了手工木製鑰匙圈當作送給摯友的紀念禮物。

examples.en: The night market is filled with stalls selling unique artisan souvenirs.
examples.zh: 夜市裡處處都是販售獨特手工紀念品的攤位。

examples.en: Let's take a quick selfie in front of Taipei 101!
examples.zh: 我們在台北 101 前面拍張快速自拍吧！

examples.en: He used a telescopic selfie stick to include all his friends in the photo.
examples.zh: 他使用伸縮自拍棒以便將所有朋友都納入合照中。

examples.en: Smiling selfies taken during vacations evoke wonderful nostalgic memories.
examples.zh: 度假期間拍攝的燦爛自拍照能喚起美好的溫馨回憶。

examples.en: The mountain peak offers a breathtaking ocean view.
examples.zh: 山頂坐擁令人屏息的壯麗海景。

examples.en: In my view, consistent daily study is more effective than cramming.
examples.zh: 在我看來，每天持之以恆地學習遠比臨時抱佛腳更有效。

examples.en: From the hotel balcony, guests enjoy a panoramic view of the harbor.
examples.zh: 從飯店陽台，住客能飽覽港口的壯闊全景。

examples.en: Learning English through pop songs is real fun.
examples.zh: 透過流行歌曲學習英語真的很有趣。

examples.en: Have fun at the water amusement park with your classmates!
examples.zh: 和你的同班同學在水上樂園玩得盡興開心喔！

examples.en: Don't make fun of others when they make innocent pronunciation slips.
examples.zh: 當別人無心念錯發音時，不要取笑他們。

examples.en: We had a wonderful family vacation in Taitung.
examples.zh: 我們在台東度過了一個精彩美好的家庭假期。

examples.en: The violinist played a truly wonderful musical piece that moved the audience.
examples.zh: 那位小提琴家演奏了一首極其美妙、深深打動聽眾的樂章。

examples.en: What a wonderful surprise to bump into an old classmate on the train!
examples.zh: 在火車上巧遇老同學真是個令人驚喜的美好緣分！

examples.en: You did a great job on your final presentation!
examples.zh: 你的期末簡報表現得非常棒！

examples.en: Dr. Sun Yat-sen is remembered as a great historical leader.
examples.zh: 孫中山先生被後人銘記為一位偉大的歷史領袖。

examples.en: Exercising regularly has a great positive impact on mental wellbeing.
examples.zh: 規律運動對心理健康有著極為顯著的正面助益。

examples.en: The fireworks display at Taipei 101 was awesome!
examples.zh: 台北 101 的跨年煙火秀真是太讚了！

examples.en: You won the championship? That is truly awesome news!
examples.zh: 你贏得總冠軍了？那真是太棒、太令人振奮的消息了！

examples.en: The guitarist played an awesome rock solo that electrified the crowd.
examples.zh: 吉他手彈奏了一段技驚四座的搖滾獨奏，點燃了全場熱情。

examples.en: Practice makes perfect; keep working diligently.
examples.zh: 熟能生巧，請繼續勤勉練習。

examples.en: The sunny autumn afternoon provided perfect conditions for an outdoor wedding.
examples.zh: 秋高氣爽的午後陽光為這場戶外婚禮提供了完美的天候條件。

examples.en: She achieved a perfect score on the rigorous national mathematics exam.
examples.zh: 她在嚴苛的全國數學統考中奪得了滿分的完美成績。

examples.en: Her English pronunciation and accent are excellent.
examples.zh: 她的英語發音與腔調非常優秀。

examples.en: The hotel provides excellent customer hospitality and first-class amenities.
examples.zh: 這家飯店提供卓越貼心的待客之道與一流的設施配備。

examples.en: Fresh seasonal ingredients are the secret behind the chef's excellent cooking.
examples.zh: 新鮮當令的食材是主廚卓越廚藝背後的美味祕訣。

examples.en: Getting adequate sleep is important for health.
examples.zh: 擁有充足的睡眠對健康非常重要。

examples.en: Effective communication plays an important role in fostering teamwork.
examples.zh: 有效的溝通在促進團隊協作中扮演著至關重要的角色。

examples.en: Never disclose important confidential personal passwords to strangers.
examples.zh: 切勿向陌生人透露重要的機密個人密碼。

examples.en: Today is a very special day for our family.
examples.zh: 今天對我們全家來說是一個非常特別的日子。

examples.en: The restaurant offers a special discount price for birthday guests.
examples.zh: 該餐廳為壽星顧客提供專屬的特別優惠價格。

examples.en: She has a special talent for learning foreign languages effortlessly.
examples.zh: 她有一種能輕鬆迅速學會外國語言的獨特天賦。

examples.en: Bubble tea is popular among people of all ages.
examples.zh: 珍珠奶茶深受各年齡層民眾的喜愛。

examples.en: Japanese anime is immensely popular with teenagers across the globe.
examples.zh: 日本動漫在全世界的青少年族群中極受歡迎。

examples.en: Hiking Elephant Mountain has become a popular weekend fitness trend.
examples.zh: 攀登象山已經成為極為風靡的週末健身熱門風尚。

examples.en: Alishan is famous for its sunrise and tea.
examples.zh: 阿里山以其日出和高山茶聞名。

examples.en: Taiwan is world-famous for its high-tech semiconductor manufacturing.
examples.zh: 台灣以其頂尖高科技半導體製造技術聞名遐邇於世。

examples.en: The famous Taiwanese author was invited to give a keynote literary speech.
examples.zh: 那位著名的台灣作家受邀發表文學專題演講。

examples.en: Everyone has different learning paces and goals.
examples.zh: 每個人都有不同的學習步調與目標。

examples.en: Cultural traditions in eastern and western countries are quite different.
examples.zh: 東西方各國的文化傳統截然不同。

examples.en: A small act of kindness can make a huge positive difference in someone's life.
examples.zh: 一點小小的善行就能為某個人的人生帶來巨大的改變。

examples.en: We go to the same junior high school.
examples.zh: 我們就讀同一所國中。

examples.en: The two identical twins wear the exact same bright yellow shirts.
examples.zh: 這對雙胞胎兄弟穿著完全一模一樣的亮黃色上衣。

examples.en: Although it was raining, they went hiking all the same.
examples.zh: 儘管下著雨，他們依然照樣去登山健行。

examples.en: True friends show real care during difficult times.
examples.zh: 真正的朋友會在困難時期展現真誠關懷。

examples.en: Is that shimmering jewel made of real diamonds or synthetic glass?
examples.zh: 那顆閃閃發光的珠寶是真鑽還是合成玻璃？

examples.en: Reading literature gives readers profound insight into real human life.
examples.zh: 閱讀文學作品能讓讀者深刻洞察真實的人生百態。

examples.en: Dreams can come true if you pursue them.
examples.zh: 只要勇於追求，夢想就能成真。

examples.en: This inspiring film is based on a true historical rescue story.
examples.zh: 這部振奮人心的電影改編自真實的歷史搜救故事。

examples.en: Loyal friends remain true and steadfast when hardships arise.
examples.zh: 患難時刻，忠誠的朋友始終真誠堅定、不離不棄。

examples.en: Mark the statements as true or false on the test.
examples.zh: 在測驗中將句子標註為正確或錯誤。

examples.en: The sounding of the fire siren turned out to be a harmless false alarm.
examples.zh: 火災警報器的聲響事後證實只是一場虛驚一場的誤報。

examples.en: Spreading false rumors on social media causes unnecessary public panic.
examples.zh: 在社群媒體上散布不實謠言會引發不必要的公眾恐慌。

examples.en: You gave the right answer to that question!
examples.zh: 你回答了那個問題的正確答案！

examples.en: Turn right at the convenience store to reach the train station.
examples.zh: 在便利商店處向右轉即可抵達火車站。

examples.en: Everyone has the fundamental human right to receive free education.
examples.zh: 每個人都享有接受基本免費教育的人權權利。

examples.en: What is wrong with your bicycle tire?
examples.zh: 你的腳拔車輪胎怎麼了？

examples.en: It is wrong to blame innocent others for your own mistakes.
examples.zh: 將自己的過錯歸咎推卸給無辜的他人是不對的。

examples.en: If anything goes wrong during system testing, alert the technician immediately.
examples.zh: 如果在系統測試期間發生任何差錯，請立即通知技術人員。

examples.en: I am doing fine, thank you for asking.
examples.zh: 我過得很好，謝謝你的關心。

examples.en: The weather forecast predicts fine sunny skies for the weekend.
examples.zh: 氣象預報指出週末將會是陽光明媚的晴朗好天氣。

examples.en: Drivers who park illegally will be forced to pay a hefty financial fine.
examples.zh: 違規停車的駕駛將被迫繳納高額罰款。

examples.en: Everything will be okay; just relax.
examples.zh: 一切都會沒事的，放輕鬆就好。

examples.en: Is it okay if I borrow your English dictionary for a few minutes?
examples.zh: 我可以借用你的英語字典幾分鐘嗎？

examples.en: The doctor confirmed that the patient is doing okay after surgery.
examples.zh: 醫生確認病人在手術後狀況良好穩定。
